## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Jīnyào tóngzǐ jīng* (T546) is a one-fascicle Sòng sūtra by Tiānxīzāi 天息災 ([天息災](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%A9%E6%81%AF%E7%81%BD)). The protagonist *Jīnyào tóngzǐ* 金耀童子 ("Boy Gold-Brilliance") is a child-bodhisattva figure.

**Abstract**

A short Mahāyāna text in the child-bodhisattva genre. Translation dated to Tiānxīzāi's pre-name-change period (980–987 CE) or his post-name-change Fǎxián period (987–1000 CE) — the catalog meta gives 天息災, suggesting pre-987. Bracket: 980–1000 CE.
